name: video-editor
description: Your own AI video editor. It studies your videos (or the creators you want to edit like) frame by frame, writes your personal editing skill from them, then edits every new video in that style: dead space cut without clipping a word, captions, text, zooms, b-roll, color and sound.

interface.shortDescription: Builds your editing style, then edits like you
interface.longDescription: Studies your own videos (or creators you want to edit like) frame by frame and writes your personal editing skill: cut rhythm, captions, text, zooms, b-roll, color and sound, with real numbers. Then it edits every new video in that style on your computer, shows you a storyboard first, checks its work against your references and exports the final MP4 with a captions file. Free, from mavgpt.ai.
defaultPrompt: Set me up to edit videos in my own style
Edit the video in my raw folder
Break down how this video is edited
